annotations.title: Ask the human to review a video

description: Ask the human to review a video or image you produced. It shows in the review panel of Mnemosyne OS and, when the human paired the review bot, on their phone (Telegram) with Approve / Change / Reject buttons. Returns the review id: pass it to mnemosyne_review_wait. The file must be an absolute path inside ~/.mnemosyne/generations, ~/.mnemosyne/voiceovers or ~/.mnemosyne/outbox (copy a render there first); anything else is refused with OUTSIDE_SEND_FOLDERS. For a retake of a review, pass its id as parentId: the panel shows the versions side by side. Needs the Mnemosyne OS app RUNNING: on macOS its window may be closed (the app stays up and the host reads the file); on Windows and Linux closing the last window quits the app, so it must be open. Scope review:ask.

fps.description: Optional: the video frame rate (e.g. 30, from the render settings). The panel steps frame by frame at this rate and the notes of the human come back with exact frame numbers. Without it the panel assumes 30 and the human can change it.

parentId.description: Optional: the review this one is a retake of.

path.description: Absolute path of the video or image (.mp4 .mov .webm .png .jpg .webp .gif).

project.description: Optional: the film project id this render belongs to (the Films window of Mnemosyne OS, e.g. "stop-aux-gadgets"; `avatar-film status <film>` prints it). The review then shows on the board of that film. A retake (parentId) keeps the project of its parent.

question.description: Optional: what you want them to look at (max 600 characters).

title.description: Short title the human sees, e.g. "Alberto birthday v2" (max 120 characters).

name: mnemosyne_review_open
